allocation.cap_rule: a task starts only if recorded spend plus unknown reservations of every trajectory under the output root, plus the margin, is within the spend cap

approval_scope: NEW direct Claude subscription usage; API-rate-equivalent caps; approve this exact plan hash

aljure.answer: done summary text, or a string computed in the session SCI worker
aljure.context_access: external-context binding and line query broker
aljure.format_corrections: at most one per task including children/resume; same accounted provider and caps
aljure.history: append-only full history in tool mode; ledger records appended messages; no model-based compaction
aljure.prompt_caching: tools and newest block marked, as in the native request
aljure.response_envelope: native-tool-v1; exactly one native tool call per response, mapped onto the EDN command schemas; text is never executed
aljure.skills: task-local code; empty retained library; no benchmark development evaluator
aljure.tools: existing EDN broker; one provider-native tool per command
aljure.worker_startup: separate 30 s bound before any expression clock starts

ES.claim: complete-harness comparison; no language-only causal claim
known_differences: Harness prompts/tool schemas differ and are recorded.
Output token allowance matches; actual requested max_tokens may differ.
Native Python packages/process tools exceed SCI capabilities.
Prime has 8MiB additional writable /work for native state.
Aljure worker initialization has per-chunk overhead; Prime loads one file.
Gateway buffers bounded SSE responses; timing differs from direct streaming.
No continual-learning or refinement-benefit claim follows from a fresh-task pilot.

prime.filesystem: read-only image plus bounded /tmp and /work; native shell tools retained
prime.output_request: native per-request choice, often model output ceiling / 3
prime.provider_usage_attribution: all requests charged; individual native ancestry/purpose unverified
prime.tools: unmodified pinned native tools, skills, refinement, subagents and messaging

shared.context: identical complete public text, external to model prompt
shared.inference: same model/settings, per-arm caps; descendants/refinement/compaction included
shared.library: fresh initial state; no prior benchmark transcripts or learned answers
shared.network: no worker egress; host-only Messages gateway

subscription_protocol.aljure_serialization: JSON response/text EDN loop; previous thinking omitted under Messages rules
subscription_protocol.cache_difference: native cache markers preserved; Aljure identity is not cached explicitly
subscription_protocol.credentials: host-only OAuth; no API fallback; no automatic refresh
subscription_protocol.identity_prefix: You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.
subscription_protocol.identity_source: pinned native OAuth serializer; same prefix for Aljure
subscription_protocol.local_cli: not used for inference; private credential source is operator-selected
subscription_protocol.native_serialization: unchanged OAuth tool names, tool blocks and signed thinking

trajectory.acquisition_schedule: proposal/promotion on tasks 1-2 only; frozen library on tasks 3-6
trajectory.cold_restart: after task 2: new runner process, JVM, worker and conversation; verified library only
trajectory.library: one content-addressed library per (arm, ordering); task k+1 gets exactly the pin committed after task k
trajectory.order: six fixed synthetic development tasks; no task or record repeats

promotion.panel: controller-only item gold from windows disjoint from every task window; no model call

rule.statement: Promote only model-proposed classifiers with at least 95% precision and 10% coverage on the fixed development panel, no execution or type error, no loss of a previously correct record, nondecreasing library coverage, precision at least 95%, and at least one additional correct record. No label-abstention adaptation or capture is used. All declines, malformed proposals, rejections and failures are retained.

trajectory.proposal: arm E: after the root answer is recorded, one structured acquisition turn: told that later tasks share the record format and many labels, the model reviews its session code and proposes a function, or declines with a one-sentence reason; its provider call is acquisition cost, apart from task inference; promotion happens outside the task, after its answer is recorded; Aljure-only (Prime unchanged)
trajectory.state: validated artifacts as arm E; structured acquisition turn (research/UNBLOCK_ACQUISITION.md mechanism B)

config.authorization_scope: Six synthetic development tasks only. ES-s101; acquire on tasks 1-2, cold restart, frozen library on new tasks 3-6. No held-out access. Exact plan approval required.

case_reuse.claim: Disjoint records and feature tuples; development lifecycle only, not held-out generalization.
case_reuse.previous_model_exposure: New synthetic development tasks; no live model has received them in this experiment.

command_contract.scope: Aljure root and descendants share one durable correction allowance; all inference charged within existing caps; each command is one provider-native tool call mapped onto the existing EDN command schemas; text is never executed; tool-mode history is append-only

sealed_heldout.rule: Unchanged and unused. Held-out rows are never decoded; held-out paths are never opened.

promotion_rule.statement: Promote only model-proposed classifiers with at least 95% precision and 10% coverage on the fixed development panel, no execution or type error, no loss of a previously correct record, nondecreasing library coverage, precision at least 95%, and at least one additional correct record. No label-abstention adaptation or capture is used. All declines, malformed proposals, rejections and failures are retained.
